ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Completed"), $RecordType.DeveloperName = "Candidate_Submission", $Profile.Name = "Partner Community User" ), AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Ready for Review"), Candidates_to_submit__c > Actual_Candidate_submitted__c, ISBLANK( Incomplete_Submission_Reason__c ), $RecordType.DeveloperName = "Candidate_Submission", $Profile.Name = "Partner Community User" ) )
